entities.title: UTV-first examples
entities.summary: One test class per UTV type or class (CivilDateTests, ZonedIntentTests, UtvValidatorTests, …), grouped by function in #regions: how to do each task with UTV, compared with .NET.
entities.purpose: Organized by UTV's classes and functions. Where UTV and .NET agree, the expected value is computed with .NET in EXPECTATIONS; where they differ, it is a literal and the doc comment's Compared with: sentence says what .NET does. Partial operations assert the outcome's status and diagnostic code. Tests that illustrate a side-by-side task are wrapped in // BEGIN <task-id> … // END <task-id>.
boundaries: The code between task markers appears verbatim on docs/side-by-side.md; after changing it, regenerate the page (runbooks.json).
Zone operations use Fixtures.DemoZoneRules(), never the host's tz database.
